what: Hardware: one 16 GB NVIDIA RTX 2000 Ada (CC 8.9), not the 20 GB A4500 the budget assumed. Per the plan's S0/F2 branch for a 16 GB Ada card, the HF engine is exp17's FP8 W8A8 loader (the screen's own precision and card), not bf16.
consequence: precision equals the screen's; bf16-specific statements are not made

what: vLLM ran Qwen/Qwen3-8B-FP8 with weight-only FP8 Marlin kernels, eager, torch.compile off (no C compiler on the machine, as in exp18).
consequence: the thinking-on arm and the HF arms use different FP8 implementations; A8 bounds the difference on one cell

what: The screen's escape rule ('N=10 rule') is not defined on the run volume; reconstructed as excess >= 0.20 and pass ratio >= 0.85 on the k 0-9 slots (reproduces T03 7/15, T2 3/15; excess-only reading gives T2 5/15, reported).

T03 unit: exp17's FP8 T03 norms are 1.32x (median) the protocol-v4 unit (exp13) used in the 2x2; alpha 1 on T03 is therefore a weaker push than the screen's alpha 1 (the engine check uses exp17's unit).
consequence: the committed T03 power expectation is optimistic; a unit-adjusted sensitivity is in results/expectations.json

what: Unit sensitivity recomputed on the FP8 W8A8 engine (bf16 does not fit the card), results/unit_sensitivity.json.
The first vLLM launch was stopped by this artifact's RAM watchdog, which counted page cache; fixed to working set (usage - inactive file) before any decisive sample; only engine load was lost.
OpenRouter GET /key returns 403 through the proxy; spend is tracked from usage.cost (results/costs.json, judge cost files).
A8 FP8 cross-check compares vLLM FP8 (Marlin) with HF FP8 W8A8 (bf16 HF cannot load on 16 GB); exp18's FP8-vs-bf16 bound on T2 is cited.
Figures rendered with matplotlib directly from the result dictionaries (not through the aii-data-fig-gen spec renderer).
Label 'disputed' (judge unavailable or over cap) is treated as 'unresolved' (excluded, with sensitivities).
Batch sizes per task decided by the committed rule: {'T2': 20, 'T03': 20, 'T1': 20, 'T2think': 10}.
consequence: constant within task across all arms

what: Drop decisions applied: none from the extrapolation; optional arm (i) (T1 thinking on, ~1.5 h) not run: less than 1.5 h of wall clock remained after G2.
consequence: T1 thinking-on statements are not made

what: The plan's (ii) causal-masking identity (max |diff| = 0 between thinking-on and -off clean S states) cannot hold bit-exactly under FP8 prefill of different lengths; the measured difference is logged (results/tpn_causal_mask_check.json).
consequence: PN in (ii) is anchored to the thinking-on clean prefill

what: Two venvs (.venv_hf, .venv_vllm) instead of one 'uv run': the vLLM script is run with .venv_vllm/bin/python; every other stage with .venv_hf/bin/python method.py --stage.
